# Cyber Access Protocol

> A 2D cyber-security action platformer about a junior operator restoring a locked-down technology tower and uncovering the adversary attacking its records.

Cyber Access Protocol is a single-player, offline game set in Asterion Tower. It spans
50 levels and 40 missions across five chapters, from the tower lobby to the city core.
The final chapter, The Last Signal, adds nine security disciplines, an Evidence
Workbench, ten new bosses and three endings.

## Main pages

- [Overview](index.html): What Cyber Access Protocol is, the incident, design pillars and key facts.
- [Campaign](campaign.html): All 50 levels across five chapters, with a screenshot for every level.

- [Gallery](gallery.html): 64 screens from the game, filterable by campaign, bosses, interface and endings.
- [Field Manual](field-manual.html): The Last Signal's nine disciplines, Evidence Workbench, ten bosses and three endings.
- [The Journey](changelog.html): How the campaign grew chapter by chapter.
- [Press Kit](press.html): Fact sheet, approved copy, cast, screenshots, logo and current status.

## Key facts

- 50 levels, 40 missions, five chapters.
- Single-player and offline; no account, leaderboard or online requirement.
- Windows PC; more platforms to be announced.
- English and Urdu, with full right-to-left support.
- Three endings chosen at the Level 50 command lock.
- Fictional setting. The game never touches real systems, credentials or networks.
